description: Traceability tests. Every number in the model must be reachable from GEOMETRY-CONTROL.md, and every source cited there must exist in SOURCE-REGISTER.md and have been read. Run with: python scripts/validate_dimensions.py

tests.title: Every source cited by a control exists in the source register
Every control graded A, B or C cites at least one source
Every placeholder control cites no source
tests.rationale: A sourced value belongs in the control table, not the placeholder table. A placeholder must not appear to rest on evidence.

tests.title: Every control reference on a part resolves to a control ID
Every open question cited by a part exists in GEOMETRY-CONTROL.md section 5
Every part declares a non-empty source_basis
No part claims a drawing, photo, mesh or photogrammetry basis at Milestone 1
tests.rationale: Milestone 1 imports no external geometry. Any such basis would be an unsupported claim, and would also fabricate a MEASURED count.

tests.title: Every source cited by a control has been read and marked verified
tests.rationale: Registration is not verification. SRC-007, SRC-008 and SRC-009 are registered and unread; this test is what stops any of them grading a control. HOW-TO-DESIGN.md section 11 records what trusting a secondary's gloss cost on the Manhattan Bridge.

tests.title: Every unverified registered source appears in the verification queue
tests.rationale: An unread source that nobody has committed to reading is a dangling claim about future work.

tests.title: Every part is assigned to a system in the handoff taxonomy
Every part records review_status and last_modified_by_agent
The parts manifest was generated from the current GEOMETRY-CONTROL.md
tests.rationale: Catches a stale build after an edit to the control document. On the Manhattan Bridge this caught the mistake every single time it happened. Verified to fail when the control document is edited without rebuilding.

tests.title: Every placeholder control is linked to a registered open question
tests.rationale: A placeholder with no named open question is a guess nobody has agreed to retire.

tests.title: No control cites a negative control
tests.rationale: SOURCE-REGISTER.md section 5 registers the Manhattan Bridge, the Brooklyn Bridge, the inherited four-track taxonomy and this repository's own outputs as material that must never grade anything here.

tests.title: Every registered negative control is still declared
tests.rationale: Guards against a future edit quietly deleting the negative controls, which would remove the only mechanism preventing cross-contamination between three similar East River suspension bridges.

tests.title: Census of controls whose evidence is a single source
tests.rationale: Most of this model rests on SRC-004 alone. Surfacing the concentration is more useful than pretending it is not there.

tests.title: No control dimension cites a visual-only source
tests.rationale: A photograph or a video shows what exists and how it is arranged; it does not state a number. AGENT-INSTRUCTIONS.md section 8 allows extracted frames to help with continuity and orientation but not to override geometry without scale control points, and SRC-011 is a watermarked 960x540 preview with no camera metadata and no control points. Material rules are deliberately exempt: 'that pier is masonry' is a claim a photograph can support. Verified to fail when a CTL- row is given SRC-011 as a source.
